subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Keeps a good table**

options.text: Provides food to the poor regularly

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Serves generous and high-quality meals'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Keeps a good table"** means to provide plentiful and excellent food to guests. (अच्छा भोजन परोसना / उत्तम आतिथ्य करना)

 
 
• **Example:** My grandmother keeps a good table; every guest leaves the house satisfied and happy.
 
 
 
• **"Serves generous and high-quality meals"** refers to offering abundant and delicious food with warm hospitality. (उदार और उत्तम भोजन परोसना)
 
 
• **Example:** The host served generous and high-quality meals during the festival celebration.
 
 
 
• Thus, the idiom clearly conveys the idea of excellent hospitality through food.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maintains a disciplined home** (अनुशासित घर बनाए रखना): Keeping order and rules strictly in the household.

 
 
• **Example:** She maintains a disciplined home where everyone follows a routine.
 
 
 
• **Follows religious rules strictly** (धार्मिक नियमों का कड़ाई से पालन करना): Observing religious customs carefully.
 
 
• **Example:** He follows religious rules strictly during the holy month.
 
 
 
• **Provides food to the poor regularly** (गरीबों को नियमित रूप से भोजन देना): Offering charity in the form of meals.
 
 
• **Example:** The organization provides food to the poor regularly as part of its mission.
